description:
Frankey and Coy sit down with actor, comedian, SNL legend, and DC fan Bobby Moynihan to talk Man-Bat, Batman, comics, collecting, and his favorite DC role: The Penguin in Batman: The Audio Adventures.

From the wild story behind Bobby's giant Batman costume to his lifelong obsession with Jim Lee, this conversation gets deeply nerdy, very funny, and surprisingly personal. Plus, Bobby reveals what makes his take on Man-Bat so weird, how he approaches Batman, and why collecting has been part of his life since childhood.

✅ Bobby Moynihan reveals how he found his chaotic, comedy-driven take on Man-Bat
✅ The unbelievable story behind Bobby's full Batman costume, Sam Raimi, and one very embarrassing Halloween
✅ Bobby tells the story of meeting Jim Lee and the comic that started his lifelong collecting obsession
✅ Why Batman: The Audio Adventures and his take on Penguin remain Bobby's favorite work
✅ Bobby opens up about collecting toys, comics, Funko Pops, Star Wars figures, and the DC fand
title: DC Studios Showcase Official Podcast | Bobby Moynihan on Man-Bat, The Penguin, Collecting | HBO Max
